# Tabs along the top (`tab-bar = top`; tests/run.sh gives this run a
# config of its own). Read back as text: the names the tabs show.
#
# A tab at a prompt goes by its shell and the folder's last part (Rex's "zsh ~").
type:cd @DIR@/top-a
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-strip:zsh top-a
tab:new
wait:0.5
type:cd @DIR@/top-b
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-strip:zsh top-a
expect-strip:zsh top-b
# Renamed in place in its tab: Return keeps it.
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:renamed
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-strip:renamed
expect-tab:renamed
# The keyboard went back to the terminal.
type:echo STRIP-OK
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:STRIP-OK
shot:tab-strip.png
